name: phone-iphone
source: iPhone 14: 390x844 CSS px at 3x (Apple specifications), 6 CPU cores. Safari has no navigator.userAgentData and no navigator.deviceMemory. Safari on iOS 26 ships WebGPU, so an adapter is present; its limits are unmeasured and use the specification floor. GPU limits are the WebGPU specification default limits (the floor every adapter must meet), not a measurement of this device.
